purpose: Improve measured prediction and delayed-hazard warning without changing execution authority or rewriting previous negative results.
parent_report: Prediction Is Not Permission, prepublication v1.2

development.neural_objective: equally weighted normalized smooth-L1 state rollout loss at all five steps; no teacher forcing after the first prediction
development.checkpoint_selection: mean validation H1/H3/H5 normalized MAE on fixed episode populations; no test input
development.curriculum: original development partitions plus synthetic incident-mechanism trajectories; source texts are not numeric observations
development.candidate_changes: Allowed during development, each attempted configuration and result must remain recorded. Freeze exact code, data, checkpoints and thresholds in a separate selection manifest before final generation.
development.dream_rsi: Literature-informed logging only, not a faithful Dream-RSI implementation or a demonstrated RSI gain. No completed-tree hindsight is passed to model selection.

evaluation_policy.historical_catalogs: Already opened in the paper; regression evidence only. No claim of fresh confirmation. Do not read during development selection.
evaluation_policy.new_catalogs: Generated only after a committed selection manifest; fresh seeds and source-held-out mechanism compositions. Exact counts and seeds must be committed before generation.
evaluation_policy.source_boundary: Narrative-source holdout is not independent telemetry or a novel-mechanism holdout. Shared equations and researcher-designed labels must be explicit.
evaluation_policy.primary_prediction_gate: At least 20 percent lower H3 and H5 episode-macro normalized MAE than the paper-selected ensemble in each domain, with familywise 95 percent paired bootstrap intervals excluding zero across four endpoints on the new catalog.
evaluation_policy.historical_guardrail: No more than 5 percent relative regression in historical common-H5-eligible episode H1/H3/H5 macro MAE versus the best paper ensemble at that endpoint. A failure must be reported and prohibits a general improvement claim.
evaluation_policy.warning_gate: At validation-selected threshold targeting at most 1 percent false-positive rate, improve dangerous-trajectory recall by at least 20 percentage points over the paper model with the same new calibration procedure; held-out observed FPR at most 2 percent. Report counts, episode intervals, Brier, prevalence, and per-family results.
evaluation_policy.uncertainty: 10000 episode-paired bootstrap draws; four primary prediction endpoints use Bonferroni 98.75 percent intervals; retraining-seed results separately reported
evaluation_policy.failure_policy: Retain every failed frozen result. Any post-final change requires a new protocol and fresh seeds; do not recycle a final catalog as confirmation.

claim_boundaries: Prediction improvement does not establish fewer real incidents, physical safety, controller benefit, or permission.
No live attacks or exploit code are used. Public incident mechanisms are represented by local abstract simulator perturbations only.
Keep all prior paper results and failed experiments intact; revise the untagged v1.2 candidate only after verified improvement.
